about.title: About SLMC
about.description1: Your Trusted Lifestyle Solution Partner S & L Management and Consulting GmbH (SLMC) is a leading Swiss multi-family office, serving ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families from our headquarters in Canton Schwyz, Switzerland. We offer a comprehensive suite of tailor-made advisory services, including wealth management, family succession planning, and private lifestyle solutions.
about.description2: By combining in-depth expertise with a personalized approach, we ensure your family's evolving needs are seamlessly taken care of, letting you focus on what truly matters. Experience excellence with SLMC and discover a new standard in family office services.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subTitle: SLMC - Your Lifestyle Solutions Expert.
aboutUs.description1: At S & L Management and Consulting LLC (SLMC), we are proud to be your trusted partner for comprehensive lifestyle solutions and family office services. Our commitment to excellence is grounded in a broad spectrum of industry experience, a dedication to personalized service, and a global network of esteemed partners.
aboutUs.description2: SLMC is headquartered in Canton Schwyz (Switzerland), the central Swiss canton bordered by Lake Zürich and Lake Lucerne, known for its Finance, Blockchain and Health Tech Cluster in Switzerland. SLMC has its presence as well in Beijing (PRC).
aboutUs.description3: We collaborate closely with selected premium partners in Switzerland and Asia to craft comprehensive and individual lifestyle solutions to families or individuals with business or private interest in Switzerland and Asia.

team.title: Our Team
team.description1: SLMC is a team with diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Our commitment to excellence is underpinned by a rich tapestry of experience and a dedication to personalized service. Our Swiss Team is leading by Prof. Dr. Andreas Svoboda. We work closely together with premium selected external partners specialize in navigating the complexities of the financial world, including banking, insurance, and family office services. With a keen understanding of the unique challenges faced by UHNWI, we deliver tailored solutions to meet the highest standards.
team.description2: SLMC proudly announces the inauguration of its Beijing Desk in response to growing customer demands across Asia. Spearheaded by the dynamic Ms. Lingnan Ren, our dedicated team stands ready to serve you in Mandarin, ensuring seamless communication and unparalleled assistance.

1.name: Prof. Dr. Andreas Svoboda
1.description: With over two decades in the global financial services industry, Prof. Dr. Svoboda is also a mentor, coach, and respected academic at Swiss universities. He leads our team in delivering comprehensive private and family lifestyle solutions, tailored to your unique goals.

2.name: Ms. Lingnan Ren
2.description: Equipped with a strong academic background in Economics from Hebei University of Technology, Ms. Ren brings invaluable experience from Mingya Insurance and the media/publishing sectors. Fluent in English and Mandarin, she heads SLMC’s Beijing Desk—offering personalized assistance and world-class service to a diverse clientele.

insurancePensions.title: Insurance & Pensions
insurancePensions.description: Insurance and occupational pensions are the regulated core of what we do. As an independent broker registered with FINMA (intermediary register no. F01470698), SLMC advises Swiss companies and private clients on corporate and private insurance, BVG/LPP pension solutions, employee benefits and risk management — from the first analysis through tendering and placement to claims.

corporate.title: Corporate Insurance
corporate.description: We map the risks your company actually carries, then design and place the cover that matches them. You keep one point of contact for tenders, renewals and day-to-day policy questions.

private.title: Private Insurance
private.description: A structured review of everything you and your family already hold — health, life, household, liability, motor and legal protection — followed by a clear recommendation on what to keep, change or cancel.

bvg.title: Occupational Pensions (BVG/LPP)
bvg.description: Your pension plan is one of the largest items on a Swiss payroll and one of the most valued benefits. We compare providers, model the cost of each option and design a plan that works for the company and for its people.

employeeBenefits.title: Employee Benefits
employeeBenefits.description: Accident, daily sickness benefit and supplementary health cover, arranged as one coherent package and explained to your employees in plain language.

riskManagement.title: Risk Management
riskManagement.description: Not every risk belongs with an insurer. We help you identify and quantify your exposures, then decide which ones to retain, reduce or transfer — with the reasoning documented.

claims.title: Claims & Ongoing Support
claims.description: When something happens you speak to your adviser, not a call centre. We notify the insurer, negotiate on your behalf and stay with the file until it is settled.

familyOffice.title: Family Office & Private Clients
familyOffice.description: Beyond insurance and pensions, we coordinate the everyday and long-term matters that families, entrepreneurs and private clients would rather not handle alone — relocation, wealth and succession planning, tax and legal specialists, healthcare, property and whatever else the year brings.

relocation.title: Relocation Services
relocation.description: Make your move stress-free with our specialized relocation services. From destination research to settling-in support, we handle every detail for a smooth transition—no matter where life takes you.

wealthPlanning.title: Wealth Planning
wealthPlanning.description: Secure your financial future with our expert wealth planning solutions. We develop customized strategies that align your assets with your personal goals and aspirations—ensuring long-term growth and stability.

taxLegal.title: Tax & Legal Advice
taxLegal.description: Navigate complex tax and legal landscapes with confidence. Our advisors provide strategic guidance to optimize your financial position and ensure full compliance with relevant regulations.

healthcare.title: Healthcare Management
healthcare.description: Enjoy first-class healthcare through our partnerships with leading providers. We coordinate everything from routine check-ups to specialized treatments, ensuring prompt and premium medical services.

realEstate.title: Real Estate Services
realEstate.description: Find your perfect home or investment property with our real estate experts. From property searches and negotiations to seamless closings, we make your real estate journey both rewarding and efficient.

bespoke.title: Bespoke Services
bespoke.description: Experience truly customized solutions with our exclusive Bespoke Services. We address your unique requirements with unparalleled attention to detail and service excellence.

internationalSolutions.title: International Solutions
internationalSolutions.description: Families and entrepreneurs rarely keep their lives inside one border. We coordinate cross-border planning across Switzerland, Europe and Asia, and open the door to regulated investment providers, banks and specialists — so that the pieces in each jurisdiction fit together.

crossBorder.title: Cross-Border Planning
crossBorder.description: Where you live, where you work and where your assets sit are often three different answers. We coordinate the insurance, pension and planning consequences of that with the specialists in each country.

investmentProviders.title: Regulated Investment Providers
investmentProviders.description: We do not manage your money. We introduce you to licensed Swiss and international providers, compare their mandates and fees side by side, and stay involved to review how they perform.

globalMobility.title: Global Mobility & Expatriates
globalMobility.description: Arriving in Switzerland, sending staff abroad or moving on again — each step changes what cover you need and what you are entitled to. We prepare those moves before they happen.

asiaDesk.title: Asia Desk
asiaDesk.description: Our Beijing desk serves clients with interests in Switzerland and Asia in Mandarin, working with a network of vetted local partners on both sides.

insights.title: Family Business Management
insights.subTitle: By Dr. Andreas Svoboda
insights.description1: Running a family business is a balancing act—blending tradition with innovation, family ties with financial responsibility. Family Business Management explores the unique challenges and opportunities of family enterprises, offering insights for success.
insights.description2: Family businesses thrive on relationships—both their greatest strength and challenge. Family Business Management explores ownership, governance, succession, and family dynamics while addressing fiscal responsibilities and global influences. Through real-life case studies, it highlights successes, common pitfalls, and strategies for sustainable growth. Whether you're passing the torch or stepping into leadership, this guide ensures business longevity without compromising family bonds.
